title: job_extract
description: Structured extraction of one raw posting. Fields mirror skeleton.contracts.JobRow. Provenance (board/job_id/url/posted_at/scraped_at) and dedup_key are attached by the caller, NOT the LLM. Axis ratings live in axis_ratings.json (a separate call).

job_title.description: Raw job title as posted (keep original language).

entry_level.description: True if entry-level (신입 / 경력무관 / 인턴), False if experienced (경력), null if unclear.

required_software.description: CANONICAL tool ids only (see normalise_skill / config.skill_aliases). Lowercase snake ids like 'blender', 'unreal', 'figma'.

remote_flag.description: True if the posting offers remote/hybrid work (재택 / 재택근무 / 원격 / 원격근무 / 하이브리드 / remote). False if it explicitly requires full-time office presence. Null if not stated.

site_intensity.description: 0-10 estimate of physical site-work demand: 0 = pure desk work, 3 = occasional visits (실측/미팅), 7+ = regular 현장/시공/설치/감리/출장/매장 presence, 10 = constant site labour. Null if the posting gives no signal.

why_it_fits.description: 1-2 sentence summary of why this posting fits (or does not fit) a spatial/3D/design career switcher.

skills_to_learn.description: Tools/skills the posting demands. The scraper filters against candidate preferences downstream.

extraction_confidence.description: 0-1 confidence in this parse; lets the pipeline drop low-quality rows (e.g. < 0.4).
